Slug routing: /[slug]/edit App Router route renders the editor for that slug
Slug validation: kebab-case, 1 to 128 chars, [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]* via zod schema (port from VibeRacer)
Anonymous owner identity: cookie-issued UUID per visitor (port VibeRacer racerId.ts as builderId.ts)

Fresh-slug landing: Load existing list reads top-N recently-updated slugs from city:index sorted set
City schema: zod CitySchema with pieces[], buildings[], optional mood; strict reject on unknown fields
City versioning: hashCity() over pieces+buildings (mood excluded) returns stable hash, mirroring VibeRacer hashTrack pattern
City persistence: PUT /api/city/[slug] validates ownership cookie, computes hash, writes city:${slug}:latest and city:${slug}:version:${hash}
City load: loadCity(slug) reads city:${slug}:latest then city:${slug}:version:${hash}, falls back to empty city when KV unset
Editor: render snap-grid with default empty city
Editor: street piece palette with straight, left90, right90 piece types
Editor: street piece palette extended with scurve, scurveLeft, sweepRight, sweepLeft
Editor: intersection piece type (4-way) so streets can branch. NEW vs VibeRacer Phase 3 which targets 3-connector junction. VibeCity's 4-way intersection extends that pattern with a fourth connector.
Editor: street piece palette extended with megaSweepRight, megaSweepLeft (3x3 footprint, 49-sample centerline, MEGA_SWEEP_ARC_RADIUS = 1.5 * CELL_SIZE). Port from VibeRacer PR #80.

Multi-cell footprint plumbing: PieceSchema.footprint?: { dr, dc }[] with default [{0,0}] omitted from canonical JSON, validateClosedLoop marks every footprint cell occupied, editor place / remove / select / move / rotate / flip operate on the footprint union atomically. Port from VibeRacer Phase 0c (src/game/trackFootprint.ts).

Editor: hairpin piece type (2x3 implicit footprint, 180deg arc, 65-sample centerline, rotated connector ports on footprint cells). Port from VibeRacer PR #81. Drive-side dependency: REQ-065 (wheelContact multi-locator handling) is required for the hairpin to be drivable; porting the schema entry without REQ-065 leaves the car falling off mid-piece.
Editor: 45-arc piece type (2x2 footprint, cardinal-to-corner connector bridge) per VibeRacer Phase 1c. Required if diagonal pieces are adopted. Adopt once VibeRacer ships it.
Editor: diagonal piece type (1x1 footprint, two corner connectors NE-SW or NW-SE, length CELL_SIZE * sqrt(2)) per VibeRacer Phase 1d. Adopt once VibeRacer ships it.

8-direction connector system: Dir spans 0..7 (N=0, NE=1, E=2, SE=3, S=4, SW=5, W=6, NW=7) with corner offsets in DIR_OFFSETS and opposite(d) = (d + 4) % 8. Connector validation: cardinal matches cardinal-adjacent, corner matches diagonal-adjacent. Port from VibeRacer Phase 0d (src/game/track.ts). Required for diagonal pieces and intersections.

Segment-based path: TrackPath carries segments: PathSegment[] with cellToLocators: Map<string, Locator[]>. Required for branching streets and intersections. Port from VibeRacer Phase 0b (src/game/trackPath.ts).

wheelContact: multi-locator candidate evaluation. For a wheel's cell, read path.cellToLocators (fallback to cellToOrderIdx for single-locator cells), iterate every candidate piece index, compute distanceToCenterline against each, pick the closest. Without this, multi-cell pieces (hairpin, mega sweep, future arc45 / diagonal) silently report on-street status against the wrong centerline mid-piece and the car falls off. Port from VibeRacer PR #81 (src/game/wheelContact.ts wheelTrackContact).

Drive mode HUD: live speed readout (magnitude with direction indicator and a [0, 1] bar fill) plus a static controls hint (WASD / arrow keys / Esc). Hides while the pause menu is open. Does not show lap timers, checkpoints, or any race scoring (REQ-037 anti-feature stays in force).

Drive mode respawn: pressing R resets the car to the spawn anchor with zero speed, snaps the chase camera, and clears the pressed-key set so a wedged or off-world car can recover without reloading the page. Skipped while paused. Listed in the HUD controls hint.

Drive mode engine audio: lazy-initialized Web Audio rig (sawtooth oscillator + lowpass filter + gain node) whose pitch and volume track the vehicle speed; ramps to idle while paused / on respawn; mute toggle exposed via M key and a Sound on / Sound off button so a player can silence the rig without leaving the drive surface.

Drive mode minimap: top-right SVG overlay showing the city silhouette (street pieces and buildings as small squares) and the live player car position as a heading-rotated triangle. Renders only when a car is mounted and the pause menu is closed (mirrors REQ-066 HUD visibility). Letterboxes the city bounds into a square viewport so the projection scale stays uniform regardless of city aspect ratio. Does not show lap timers, checkpoints, or any race scoring (REQ-037 anti-feature stays in force).
